fire_override.effect: May require greater separation; never silently reduces a base setback.

front.rule: Up to 50% of building-envelope width may use minimum; remainder uses standard, floor by floor.

rear.alley_credit: One-half alley width, capped at 10 ft; on-premises rear setback may not be below 5 ft.

street_side.facade_encroachment: Up to 50% of facade may encroach 5 ft into required street-side yard, floor by floor.

projection_exceptions.treatment: SEPARATE_CONDITIONAL_RULE; never deducted from base setback without qualifying feature evidence
